name: LandSignal
install:
cd apps/web && npm ci
cd apps/api && python3 -m pip install -e . -q

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Next.js on http://localhost:3000 (dual-stack ::) — Cursor auto-forwards this port

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd apps/api && AUTO_DISCOVER_ON_STARTUP=false LAND_ALERTS_MONITOR_ENABLED=false python3 -m uvicorn landsignal.main:app --host :: --port 8000
